Nora Blake: Tiny kudos post 3: Ethan and Hana coordinated the surprise coffee cart for yesterday's late deploy crew 3 it made the 2am window way more bearable :coffee:
Ethan Park: Noted. big thanks to @Ravi who handled the playlist (priority: mellow bops) and to Carlos for scouting decaf options. :musical_note::coffee:
Ravi Singh: glad the playlist passed QA :joy: also shoutout to the oncall buddies who stayed calm and triaged quickly 3 especially @Hana who debugged a flaky script at 02:10.
Hana Kim: thanks! the root cause was a bad env var in staging, fixed with a 2-line patch. wouldve been lonelier without the cart and those cookies.
ops-bot: Incident summary: staging-deploy-2026-03-21 triggered 1 P1, mitigated in 47m. Auto-suppress rules prevented 120 duplicate alerts.
Carlos Mendes: Facilities put out those little handwritten tags 3 people loved the dog sticker on the oat milk carton. tiny things matter.
Nora Blake: Thinking we should make a rotating "late-shift appreciation" sign-up so the load isn't always on the same folks. reactions: :thumbsup: for yes, :thinking_face: to discuss logistics.
Ethan Park: :thumbsup:
Ravi Singh: :thumbsup:
Hana Kim: :thinking_face: can we alternate between snacks and gift cards? keeps it fair.
Carlos Mendes: I can draft a simple rota spreadsheet and share tomorrow.
Nora Blake: Awesome. final shoutout to everyone who dropped by the war room last night 3 team vibes were top-tier. :sparkles:
